Also, a bit of a trick to this game. Lust isn't like affection, there is no downside to grinding it, so you could always just maintain a scheduled grind, scheduled as in you do so much per in game day up to the maximum possible in one day. This should, in theory, give you a surplus of lust so that you won't miss lust events when they are tied to or locked by a main event since you will automatically see the scenes within that surplus once you meet the other requirements, assuming there are any.

Don't get me wrong, he's still a degenerate and a sorry excuse for a human being, but he's been far less completely iredeemable lately which is an interesting thing to be less of.

Most of the things he's done lately that are both 1.) morally wrong and 2.) not simply maintaining a status quo have been done outside his control (e.g: Molly) as far as I remember.

For instance, do you think reset 1 or 2 Sensei would have turned down Nikki? (or at least told her that he'd be with her so as to sleep with her) That's massively out of character for the earlier him.

Basically what I'm saying is that Sensei seems to be experiencing character growth (or perhaps realisiation?) and it's strange to me because my internal conceptualisation of Sensei is of a complete scumbag.

Even the morally wrong things he's (intentionally) done recently seem to be mostly just him maintaining the current state of his relationships (like continuing to allow Chika to think that they're exclusive, or fucking Haruka). I see this as the current Sensei inheriting immoral acts from his past self rather than commiting them himself.

Sensei is becoming more and more of a "real" character, and it's kind of freaking me out.

What do you mean by calling out? If you mean getting mad at you for going after Chika when she asked you not to, she only gets mad at you specifically if you did Schadenfreude before the first beach event. Otherwise, she will still be upset since she gets rejected either way, but it won't lock you out of seeing certain things. The next few events are where it really starts to branch, like claiming not to be mad when she clearly is when you see her for the first time after the first beach event if you did Schadenfreude before the first beach event while not making any mention of anger at all if you didn't, though things do generally play out the same, including what big things come next. There's also a kiss in a later event that ONLY happens if you didn't do Schadenfreude before the first beach event, this is absent in the case that you did.

Having too many points in affection, the main stat that you build up before you ever even get the first lust event, already CAN screw things up. The Schadenfreude event thing is a very good example of this as having too many points with Chika may trigger it if you just so happen to visit the event location with enough points. Grinding them up to a point is a good thing, grinding them to the point that you have reached the cap for every event in the game before you get anywhere near the current last event is bad because it can cause a long event marathon where you basically have no control over when main events trigger unless they require a certain location. These event marathons can cause all sorts of triggers to go off for missing events if certain events are in that marathon. There are also several lust events that are part of a main event and they are missable if you do the main event they are tied to without enough lust, which is especially true if you trigger an event marathon that includes a main event with a lust event tied to it.

The first, and so far only, time I was a bad homie (did Schadenfreude before the first beach event), I had ground up enough Chika affection to trigger Schadenfreude before being a bad homie was even possible and triggered Schadenfreude, making me an instant bad homie in the first beach event in the next version after that one since the first beach event and schadenfreude were one version apart. I have not made that mistake again.

posts.content_html_raw:
akselx said:
I don't think there's any other realistic interpretation from both logical and dramatical perspectives. If it weren't about pregnancy, that whole sequence of events just don't work narratively and loses any punch it had. Fake pregnacy? Sorry, but that's super lame.
Click to expand...
There's also the fact that Sensei's revulsion to the idea of becoming a father is a central component of his personality that is addressed repeatedly throughout the story, which is a stupid character detail to add unless it's somehow relevant, and honestly, I think it's far more relevant than JUST the Ayane situation.

The game repeatedly brings up pregnancy as something that makes Sensei uncomfortable. At one point it's described as a feeling of physical illness. One of the "spooky" moments has a crying child playing in the audio. When a girl uses pregnancy or breeding as a sexy roleplay thing, it immediately turns him off.

Chekov's Gun: If you create a detail and constantly draw attention to it, it has to be relevant.

We have the flashback scene where Sensei and Maya where Maya talks about them both hating babies. A scene that takes place on the rooftop. And the rooftop is only used as a location immediately prior and during a reset.

Pregnancy is a core theme, and there's a very real possibility it was a pregnancy that prompted Sensei to jump off the roof at the start of the game.

Speculation: I very strongly suspect that all this is tied together. The rooftop is important to the story because that was where Sensei and Maya met up, and very likely where he impregnated her. And when he found out, where he jumped from.

And thus, it's where he's drawn when it's time to end a cycle and begin a new one. And anyone carrying his child is also drawn there.

This is why Maya's INCREDIBLY bitter about having to repeat the same 3-4 months over and over again, because it's the first half of a pregnancy that never ends. Infinite morning sickness. This would explain why she eats 2-3 times as much as the other girls. And most of the time when she's shown with a watermelon, she's holding it like a pregnancy belly. Since she was pregnant before this process began, when the world resets, she gets reset to early in the pregnancy, and remains on the roof.

But Ayane was no longer pregnant because her restore point, so to speak, is pre-pregnancy, so when the reset ends, she poofs back to where she should be.

It also makes me curious about the other time we see one of the girls on the roottop (Bluejay). This was a bit earlier before the reset of that cycle, so that could very well be an exception, but pregnancy+rooftop+jump feels awfully.....loop-like. And someone intervened pretty heavily in that scene to put her back on the roof, so it's possible her pregnancy was undone at that point by whoever intervened.

spoilers.title: Here's the fix
spoilers.html:
Mac updates have been wonky recently. For some reason, the update patch did not work for me. I re-downloaded the entire game, and I had to do some work.

1) Extract game.
2) You should be left with the LiL game itself, a folder titled "game," and two files (LessonsInLove0.22.0.py & LessonsInLove0.22.0.sh)

Check the file size of your game. If it's less than 6.4bGB, you're having the same problem as me.

Mac updates have been wonky recently. For some reason, the update patch did not work for me. I re-downloaded the entire game, and I had to do some work.

1) Extract game.
2) You should be left with the LiL game itself, a folder titled "game," and two files (LessonsInLove0.22.0.py & LessonsInLove0.22.0.sh)
3) Right click game, and click "Show Package Contents".
4) Open the folder "contents." You should see a folder titled "resources."
5) Open the folder "resources." You should see a folder titled "renpy."
Create a folder titled "autorun" within "resources." Use my spelling letter-for-letter: autorun
6) Place "renpy" "game" "LessonsInLove0.22.0.py" & "LessonsInLove0.22.0.sh" in "autorun"

I wish Subeles would fix this error, but alas, I am but a freeloader. Besides, macs aren't all too good computers for gaming purposes, anyways. Hope this helps.

So with the fact there is content with "Bad Uncle" as a flag, cheater as a flag, and IIRC there will be a good guy run or specific girl routes, has Seb ever addressed the the fact that replayability and expansion of the game will be very difficult? This game is very, very long, even with the skip button it has a decent amount of grinding and countless events currently in the game are very tied together. Additional runs for branching paths might be very rarely undertaken without some form of "Start from here" option for the player or allowable post game cheats. Additionally, for there to be paths or good guy route, due to the intertwining nature of events currently in the game, Seb will basically have to make an entire new game if he wishes to add them?
Click to expand...
What we know from Selebus may already address some of your concerns.

When we get to the purity path part of the game, you'll be given the option to choose one of the girls, and you'll play through that girl's purity path to get their purity ending. At that point, the game will take you back to the decision point, where you can pick another girl. So that's your "start from here" point that you mentioned.

What we don't know is if the bad uncle/bad homie flags are content locks that forever deny you access to an ending, or if they're branches that lead to the same location by different methods. I haven't tried bad homie to see how that plays out in later Rin events, but I could see a narrative path where Sensei has to work much harder to get there than he does under the good homie path. Yeah, you won't be able to see all content in one playthrough, but if there are enough of these either/or story routes, even if they ultimately lead to the same destination, it adds a layer of replayability.

As for the cheater flag, we have no idea what that does. It could be a giant fake-out, it could just result in the game becoming more passive aggressive in the narration, or it could actually impact continuity. We won't know until he actually implements that impact.

posts.content_html_raw:
Ok so I am really enjoying this game. This is my first time playing a game like this (I heard it mentioned as a Denpa game?) and it's been fascinating going down the rabbit hole. The characters have all be well written (which makes the horror all the more heartbreaking), and the humor (especially with characters added about halfway through the game) has had me busting a gut laughing. I don't know why Tsuneyo's little "ah" is so funny, but it's great.

That said I do have a few criticism's of a certain puzzle that you are probably tired hearing about. Putting in spoilers just in case.

1. So about that Terminal puzzle. There's nothing wrong with the puzzle itself, but would it be possible to put more puzzles of this nature early on in the game to help train us players into getting into the mindset of needing to remember things or write them down. Getting hit with this event so far in the game, and with breaks in between playing made that part a dead stop and very frustrating.

1.5 Kind of related to above, but the part where you need to listen to audio in order to progress. The voice is attached to the music setting, and I always turn the music down lower when playing renpy games so they don't overshadow sound effects. The voice creeped me out (which was awesome), but I hadn't realized it held important information i'd need to write down. The criticism here would be to put the audio option on voice or sound effects instead as I think turning music down is pretty common, but i'm not sure how complicated that is.

2. I have a feeling this is on purpose (which if it is fair enough), but does the IP address have to be so annoying to input? Unless renpy has a paste function I don't know about, typing the thing was frustrating for me. I have difficulty typing due to the stiffness of my fingers, so inputting and reinputting was not pleasant.

Other than that thank you for creating such an incredible game. I don't usually have the stomach for horror but this game has me good.

barglenarglezous said:
There's also the fact that Sensei's revulsion to the idea of becoming a father is a central component of his personality that is addressed repeatedly throughout the story, which is a stupid character detail to add unless it's somehow relevant, and honestly, I think it's far more relevant than JUST the Ayane situation.

The game repeatedly brings up pregnancy as something that makes Sensei uncomfortable. At one point it's described as a feeling of physical illness. One of the "spooky" moments has a crying child playing in the audio. When a girl uses pregnancy or breeding as a sexy roleplay thing, it immediately turns him off.

Chekov's Gun: If you create a detail and constantly draw attention to it, it has to be relevant.

We have the flashback scene where Sensei and Maya where Maya talks about them both hating babies. A scene that takes place on the rooftop. And the rooftop is only used as a location immediately prior and during a reset.

Pregnancy is a core theme, and there's a very real possibility it was a pregnancy that prompted Sensei to jump off the roof at the start of the game.

Speculation: I very strongly suspect that all this is tied together. The rooftop is important to the story because that was where Sensei and Maya met up, and very likely where he impregnated her. And when he found out, where he jumped from.

And thus, it's where he's drawn when it's time to end a cycle and begin a new one. And anyone carrying his child is also drawn there.

This is why Maya's INCREDIBLY bitter about having to repeat the same 3-4 months over and over again, because it's the first half of a pregnancy that never ends. Infinite morning sickness. This would explain why she eats 2-3 times as much as the other girls. And most of the time when she's shown with a watermelon, she's holding it like a pregnancy belly. Since she was pregnant before this process began, when the world resets, she gets reset to early in the pregnancy, and remains on the roof.

But Ayane was no longer pregnant because her restore point, so to speak, is pre-pregnancy, so when the reset ends, she poofs back to where she should be.

It also makes me curious about the other time we see one of the girls on the roottop (Bluejay). This was a bit earlier before the reset of that cycle, so that could very well be an exception, but pregnancy+rooftop+jump feels awfully.....loop-like. And someone intervened pretty heavily in that scene to put her back on the roof, so it's possible her pregnancy was undone at that point by whoever intervened.

What is the most confusing aspect of the game so far for you guys (and gals)? We've all got theories and i'd love to hear them (makes the wait interesting).
Click to expand...

I think Sensei's past is the linchpin to unravelling the most mysteries. What was his relationship like with Amy's mother, and his brother? What happened with him and Maya and Noriko (what happened with Nikki seems fairly evident at this point)? I think the answer to these questions would help explain a lot. I also think what's in the boxes Maya has Sensei carry could clear up some stuff.

On the other hand, there are others I think it wouldn't help us answer. Such as 'what is buried beneath our feet?' or 'just how many "gods" are there screwing with us, and what do they want?'

There've been a lot of theories about all these things throughout the forum. Personally I think Amy's mother was significantly older than Sensei, and took advantage of him. I think he and Maya were definitely in a relationship prior to the cycles starting. I think there was a tragedy beyond the accident that took Amy's parents from her, which involved at least Maya and Sensei. Whether or not either or both died/came close to dying and are on some kind of life support I'm not sure. Whether or not pregnancy is involved somewhere - again, I'm not sure. I feel like there's potential for Sensei's relationship with Amy to not be Uncle/Niece, but I'm not sure.

As to the gods, I think there's at least 3 we've heard about - "Hope", the god of wires, and Yasu's eyeless god who at one time had plentiful eyes. Nozomu might be a 4th. I have no clue what any of them want. Nor do I have a guess, yet, what's under our feet. Also no guesses as to what's in the boxes.

In the end, it's hard to feel sure about anything, because the clues are obscure, and they come in bits and pieces, but there's enough to make you feel like it's slowly coming together. I also feel like there's connections I could be making and aren't - either because I don't know enough information about Japanese culture, or other similar knowledge gaps.

Anyway, that's my current take on things.

I've been on this thread since pretty close to day one of the entire game and have been on his Discord ever since I signed up at the, now legacy, $30 tier. I spend time in both daily, and sure, there are white knights for every game, that is an unavoidable issue. The entire indie side of game development would have to come to a screeching halt for the white knighting to not exist. That means no developer putting out anything ever and essentially giving up their title as a game developer in the public eye. I would argue that, unless someone is defending against a valid criticism like the story going completely off the foundation Sel built, they aren't unwavering, especially if they do have a record of not agreeing with every little thing, which is what "rabid fanboys" do, they take zero comments against the game without getting defensive and they agree with everything the developer does even if it would bury the game very quickly. As an example for me personally vs an actual case of "rabid fanboys," when the rework came up, I voiced a concern that it would undermine the initial development of Ayane as she was before the first beach event by removing an early scene that shows a bit of what she was like at that point. A "rabid fanboy" would have agreed with that decision to remove this scene from the actual progression of the game. On the other hand, on Innoxia's Discord, you literally can say anything bad, even something valid, and the torches and pitchforks come out. There is A LOT of criticism of how Innoxia handled the releases around the end of 2020 into the beginning of 2021 as well as criticism for the game now having taken almost five years and we're just barely into the second area of the game. If I had said this on Innoxia's Discord, I would have been run out by the mods and everyone else because anything other than praise is completely unwelcome even with how bad development has gone.

You don't have to honor his intent, however you decide to handle it is your call, but under no circumstance is what you're asking of him necessary for him to do. I for one will honor his intent as best I can. Actually, there are other ways to force his intent to be honored, but they are overly complicated and he's never shown himself to be the type to force the issue. Assuming he knows how, there are ways to block mods from working among other ways to make it impossible to play any other way. It would just be tedious and would probably turn into a war of wills between him and the people making the mods. Randomizing any potential answers to puzzles is also possible, making a walkthrough essentially useless. Like I said, though, he has never shown himself to be the type of developer that would do all that.

You're assuming I would censor answers, I wouldn't, but I won't provide them, either. The only way to get help out of me is to show that progression was attempted as intended using every possible option and avenue available to the player in game. Then I would point the person in the right direction without giving the answer away. That is not censorship, a thing I am actually vehemently against. This is something I have also never seen on the Discord, but it is possible I missed it when it was a newer comment since I don't dig into past comments.

This is hardly a kinetic novel, those have only one path while there are several ways things can play out already and there are more paths in the plan once we get out of the dark route that is seemingly set to begin soon. The puzzles weren't even a thing until it got annoying to Sel that people clearly weren't paying attention to the story text, either using the skip function or just not reading carefully, when the story is the intended main draw of the game. Assuming I am remembering correctly, the puzzles were added in response to that issue as a way to hopefully get people to pay attention to the text as the answers, all but one, are provided at certain points. A player who is clearly not paying attention now would get stuck at these puzzles since they would not know the answers they completely skipped over.

Authors intent is the only reason Sel needs, good reason or not. It is ultimately his game and his decision as it is with all developers as long as patron perks don't give some of that authority to patrons like some other developers do. It really just boils down to 'don't like it? Don't play it' with this game and that is the stance that Sel took.

SubscribeStar was specifically started in response to certain competitors disallowing such things, so moodle is correct, that should continue to be a source for the foreseeable future even with that content.

As for the archetype, there's really no other way to do it with existing examples, yandere hasn't gotten the same level of development as a trope as the other dere archetypes. Tsundere and kuudere are the most developed with at least two different types each, and I believe there is now a third even for tsundere, but yandere has only ever had one, batshit crazy to a potentially deadly degree and completely infatuated with the love interest in question. There have been variations on the severity, basically how far the yandere is willing to go to achieve her goal, and how the yandere traits manifest, whether from in story events or the yandere starting that way, but there has been no variation that I am aware of as far as how they act. This is what initially tipped me off to Ayane at the beginning up to the first beach event and then to Ami and Noriko as possible yanderes. They almost always start out soft and subtle, obviously with the instability, and then they ramp up their yandere antics over time as other people 'get in the way' or the love interest 'stops loving her' or whatever she sees in that deluded mind (I say she because it is almost always a female who gets this archetype). On occasion, they do start out hard and fast, going from 0 to 100 in a VERY short span of time and leaving a bloodbath in their wake.

That's what makes them yanderes, the term basically translates to lovesick from Japanese to English, so it fits. That's also probably why there's little to no variation, because lovesick isn't a very broad spectrum in the same sense yanderes fit in.

This is also why I don't see Chika as possible, she didn't start with any sort of instability and she hasn't really been ramping up her antics to push other girls away at minimum. Ami, however, is a VERY different story in both regards (again I cite the initial invite over event for every girl and her one lust scene in her maid uniform as evidence). Even Rin is more of a yandere than Chika and Rin isn't really showing yandere traits, only depression induced tunnel vision and hostility toward anyone she sees as getting in her way, though not in the same way as a yandere, that is more directed at other girls that she thinks are trying to take the love interest from her, not take her from the love interest, while Rin is more the reverse.

But given the timing of when all this started, wouldn't her getting rebooted ... not be that bad? I mean it'd still be bad in the sense that the girl we grew to know would have been rewinded, but...
Click to expand...
At the start of the game, we wake up with no understanding of where we are, who we are, or who anyone else is.

This is what Maya is afraid of happening to her. It's what the Angels alluded to in the dorm event. Everythiing that made Maya Maya will be gone and replaced with a completely blank slate. And it's possible that this could begin a who-knows-how-long process with Sensei and Maya's roles are reversed, and he's constantly watching Maya get rebooted, each time hoping that THIS time, she'll come back as her old self, and eventually losing all hope that it will ever happen.


Also
What was Ayane's game plan when she wanted to tell Ami about being involved with Sensei? It seems like she wanted to keep the baby but wouldn't that chain of events lead to exactly what she was afraid of earlier (her having to move away and study in seclusion, and Sensei getting fired and neither of them ever seeing the other again)? How would she have been able to avoid that? What changed between when Kirin caught Ayane and Sensei together and the point where she decided to keep it?
Click to expand...
While Ayane is often foolish and lives with her heads in the clouds, she has acknowledged more than once that she's not stupid. She knows that getting pregnant is a disaster. If she keeps the baby, Sensei is likely lost to her forever as he gets arrested or conscripted. If she tries to get an abortion, questions get asked, and the one man she's been seen out in public with regularly probably gets arrested or conscripted anyway. There isn't a win scenario if things play out the way they would for normal people.

But Ayane isn't a normal person. She's the daughter of the second wealthiest man in the city, a man who was able to dodge the war by virtue of his wealth, and a man who could, potentially, save Sensei from the same fate. I think Ayane knows this is a long shot. But it's literally the only path forward that allows her to maintain the fantasy of the life she wants to build with Sensei.

But Sensei shot that down before she could even tell him.

Even though Selebus very likely would not agree, I've been partially in favour of piracy for a long time because there isn't much that indicates that it leads to less sales.. on the contrary, in a lot of ways it also helps people test out a product to see if it's worth it before buying. The general consensus, even among pirates, is that the officially bought product is usually better regardless.. which it usually is of course. And I am a direct example since I financially support Selebus, and I likely wouldn't have heard about the game without f95.

The positive through this could have been that it could help quality games make more sales rather than highly marketed ones through this, but a lot of things have ruined that viewpoint.. like pre-orders and early access.

My main issue used to be whether it could have been the death of single player games, but that definitely doesn't seem to be the case either.

Just remember, in any part of the community, to always encourage supporting the developers of products that you like.

Click to expand...
Only if yout are actually aware of what you are getting yourself into.
Pathologic 1 stretched the mentality of artificial difficulty as a "means to and end" to a breaking point, all the while not indicating that it's full of so much pointless walking without knowing where you actually had to walk to more often than not. It is one of the reasons - together with the poor state of release outside of Russia - why the game remained so obscure in the first place. Pathologic 2 at the very least clearly states (begrudgingly added after a patch I might add) that the high difficulty of the game is the intended experience while also providing you with information on what you potentially have missed with the simple press of a button. This sets your expectations right from the word go.
If you get thrust into a situation that feels vastly different from your set expectations it can quickly feel like an unfair shift with barely any room to adapt in, then people will inevitably feel like their experience took a turn to the worse.

On a note regarding the game, I did certainly enjoy the update and surprisingly hunting for clues, with the exception of a single riddle which left me utterly stumped and I'm absolutely not a fan of solving riddles in the first place, so if even someone like me can get gratification out of hunting for clues despite not being an inate fan of it, that should be considered some praise.

It can, but the expectations thrust upon users of this site already vastly differ from what this game delivers.

Take the story vs porn issue. There have been several cases where people have said there isn't enough or they complain about why it is only animated when there is no need to focus on the story. This is because, while F95 is technically a general use game pirating forum, it mainly contains porn games and most of those thrust the player into sex scenes quickly and very often if sex scenes are not the only thing the game has to offer at all. Meanwhile, this game focuses largely on the story with porn taking a back seat to the point where it could have been easily stripped away with almost zero actual issue. Those are vast expectation vs reality checks for anyone coming into this game.

The Honey Select and Koikatsu studios are sold for personal use, not commercial use. Technically, commercial use of those studios without a specific license for it would be illegal, and both Illusion and Fakku (who handles distribution in Western markets) have made it clear that they'll act to shut down unauthorized commercial use when they become aware of it.

However, the patron/creator relationship falls into a grey area, because "the game is free and always will be," we're just donating to help him dedicate his time to making the game and not have to worry about pesky day jobs. We're not paying for the game, we're getting early access as a perk for paying for his groceries.

Until the game is explicitly sold, it can be argued as personal use.

If Sensei doesn't make it to the roof in time, he gets mindwiped. We know from past exposition that this has happened several times, and that our Sensei is the first time he's made it past 3 resets successfully. This implies that whatever challenges he faces during the reset gets tougher.

The first reset was just a "where to go and what do once you're there" puzzle. The second needed clues from more sources. Every reset since then has had a new wrinkle added. Each time the world resets, Sensei is going to have have to navigate a more complicated process to reach the roof.

But rather than being told he faces these challenges as he navigates them without our assistance, we have to face them as well. There's a discussion to be had (and we're having it) as to whether or not its good game design, but they do represent something Sensei is actually going through at that point in the story.

I honestly like that we're being forced to contend with the same challenge Sensei is, even though I'm not a fan of the exact types of challenges being presented.

But we've known for some time that Selebus likes to troll his critics. Hell, this update goes out of its way to mock people who constantly complain about the puzzles and keep playing anyway. If you're still here, that's a choice you made. When the next reset rolls around, there will be another one of these, and it will be even more complex than it was this time around. We know it's going to happen, it's been made clear that's not going to change.

I finally finished the puzzles from the event "A Life of Prizes". I know that people already posted the answers, but for anyone interested in doing the puzzle normally, I thought I'd share a list of names of events where you can find the answers that are not given inside the puzzle room.

Main event: The Color White
Maya event: Everlasting Mercy
Transcribed from undoitall.mp3:

This is a test of the emergency broadcast system. There is no need to panic. Any interruptions you may experience (included but not limited to: visual disturbances, heightened senses of spirituality, or the changing of seasons) can simply be ignored. Everything is fine. Please continue to look up.

The coarseness of the ground upon which you sit tears microscopic holes in the fabric of a young girl's dress. It captivates you, like an unobscured horizon, or a beautiful bird you are seeing for the first time. A heron comes to mind. You find yourself pondering the difference light can make and why some things are so much prettier when left unlit. You forget this. Your mind goes somewhere else. You follow it. You end up in front of a well. You look down, but when your eyes make contact with the bottom, you realize that it is you that you are looking down upon.

When you blink, you are back at home, safe and sound. Perhaps it is time to start wearing denim.
Otoha event: Breathing in Unison
Ami event: Somnambula
Read both the dialogue in the event and the question more carefully
Main Event: The Light of Last Summer
Main Event: Stray Cat
This answer is in the room, but I'm including it in this post anyway. Only click the spoiler if you're deaf.
Transcribed from 11c.mp3:

With hands pressed to the glass, I asked him, "What else could you possibly need?" but as his footsteps disappeared down the halls of the school, I finally understood. What he possessed was too much and not too little. It was at that moment that I discovered a loose thread dancing off the hem of my sleeve. I severed it with my teeth and went home. I can still feel the thread stuck in my throat.

Are you having fun? Are you having a good time? Tell me you see me. Tell me you see me. Tell me you see me. I am so happy to be with you right now.

A life of prizes for you and yours. A world so full of open doors. So many tears and drinks to pour. At least one answer here is four.
Niki Event: Like it's Any Other Day
Maya event: Everlasting Mercy
Main Event: Word of the Day
Main Event: The Light of Last Summer
Keep eating
Main Event: Stray Cat
Happy Event: Good Boy
Main Event: There is Nothing - I don't know if this is the correct answer, since both answers offer a different solution, but this one lets you skip an annoying step.

You end up in front of a well. You look down, but when your eyes make contact with the bottom, you realize that it is you that you are looking down upon.

When you blink, you are back at home, safe and sound. Perhaps it is time to start wearing denim.

That's what pisses me off about these puzzles, they aren't actually logical-- the fact that some voice in a soundtrack mentions denim doesn't in any way mean that it is necessarily the MC's favorite fabric. Considering the theory that popped from this build on the puzzles potentially representing some in universe force trying to stop him from reaching the roof, I'm not sure it was even meant to be logical, just difficult.

Think of it this way, some unknown entity doesn't want him to reach that roof, it wants him to fail and be reset. Despite that entity's best efforts in previous resets, Sensei made it, causing the entity in question to get more and more desperate in its attempts. The puzzles could be the manifestation of those attempts and the rising difficulty a manifestation of this entity's desperation.

I'm going to also take a guess at who that entity is, either HOPE or Wire, two of the most prominently featured gods in the story who are at odds and one of which is possibly on Sensei's side, automatically making him an enemy of the other.

Not necessarily, especially if he's working with itch.io. Bear in mind -- itch.io is FAR more inconvenienced in this scenario than any one individual creator is. They have to take all these games down, deal with angered creators, look into the complaint, and put the games back up. It's a big time-sink for them. They'd be the primary actor in the suit.

...and here's where all my hours watching copyright law YouTube kicks in.

itch.io sues. This group either responds or they don't, MAYBE they offer to settle.

If they don't, judge issues summary judgement and assigns damages, which is what happened in Automattic.
If they do, their response will include their legal justification for the takedown request. If it's moral outrage, as you theorize, itch.io's attourney requests summary judgement on the grounds of lack of basis, and probably wins.
If they DO have legal basis (the one unlikely scenario I outlined above), itch.io drops the suit and the games go back off the platform. But seriously -- I doubt an "ethics group" would have that basis. Fakku might per their distribution agreement with Illusion, but if this were Fakku's doing, we'd already know.

If this is moral outrage DMCA harassment, settling is their best way out. They know they cannot win in court if it comes to that, and they're counting on the fact that lawsuits for DMCA harassment are very rare.

#NotALawyerButIWatchThemOnYouTube

"There Is Nothing" had you inputting answers that were given to you during previous events, especially 'happy' scenes, which seemed to be most of the issue as a lot of people can't handle those, and in one case the audio of "There Is Nothing" itself (this event is also one of the most contentious because of complaints over the one answer strictly being audio only while audio volume is only controlled on an all or nothing master slider, thus posing an issue for those that have less than average hearing).

The Ami events trigger automatically the morning after the Kaori event you're missing. and the second happy event you're missing triggers during the main events, which trigger after the Ami events.

To do the Kaori event, you need to call Kaori at night on a weekend. HOWEVER, before you can do that, you need to either do, or miss, Good Boy.

Which means you're also probably missing a Sara event. So focus on her to try and shake that loose.

It's become a really good game except for having to engage with the wiki after a certain point to figure out the insanely specific steps you need to unlock events that will let the plot move forward. Getting to Halloween was pretty simple (I only fell a couple of months behind schedule because I forgot to phone Kirin for her first event), but Christmas requires a nest of off-the-beaten-path actions. The bloated cast doesn't work in its favour when you don't know what's mandatory, so in effect everything is.

It's easy to quit the game thinking there's nothing to see, but then you go to x location on y day of the week, meet another new side character and suddenly get bombarded with events. The content is good, but I'm definitely getting frustrated with finding it.

posts.content_html_raw:
thevoid089 said:
Holy damn didn't know this game got DMCA and taken down on itch until I'm browsing on reddit and saw a post talked about it, is it the reason for the total rework?
Click to expand...
Strap yourself in, this gets convoluted.

For quite some time, Selebus has talked about wanting to rework the first chapter of the game, because a large chunk of it doesn't meet his self-set quality standard. He had some conflicting visions of what the project would be at first, and now that he's decided exactly what he wants it to be, he's doing a big cleanup/revision of the early game. That's the rework we're in right now.

HOWEVER, there was a DIFFERENT rework back in January. That was due to Patreon deciding the character models looked too young, so he had to go through and write all the sex scenes out of the game and recreate the game as "Legend of the Huggy Boy" for Patreon, which is why we now have a sex and no-sex version for download here.

What appears to have happened with itch.io is that an ethics group DMCA'd the game last week. This is an all-new wrinkle, and we don't have much more data than that it's an "ethics group" of some sort behind it. Selebus has stated that at least one KK-derived game has been restored to itch.io since the takedown, so it's probably only temporary.

posts.content_html_raw:
NightPhoenix said:
unable to progress beyond the 'My heart is full' event as it immediately goes into what i call the 'semblance of soul' bug where despite no having any of the prerequisites it activates this event breaking the quest chain? does anyone know of a fix or a work around or at least on how to avoid this bug? since the main quest stops progressing once this bug happens. its possible this is a bug from seeing another random event early which i didnt think about too much till now.
Click to expand...
You may have a copy that is bugged, download again.

Raf-Raf said:
Hmm, it's probably just me but I don't remember the happy events this uhh non-scary I guess.
Maybe I just got used to it in the past but the newer ones tend to be bland for what I'm looking for but hey, maybe the next ones will surprise me.
Click to expand...
You might not be remembering as well because of the break you had from the game, resulting in them seeming more scary. Just a theory, not sure what is the actual cause.

thevoid089 said:
Holy damn didn't know this game got DMCA and taken down on itch until I'm browsing on reddit and saw a post talked about it, is it the reason for the total rework?
Click to expand...
barglenarglezous said:
Strap yourself in, this gets convoluted.

For quite some time, Selebus has talked about wanting to rework the first chapter of the game, because a large chunk of it doesn't meet his self-set quality standard. He had some conflicting visions of what the project would be at first, and now that he's decided exactly what he wants it to be, he's doing a big cleanup/revision of the early game. That's the rework we're in right now.

HOWEVER, there was a DIFFERENT rework back in January. That was due to Patreon deciding the character models looked too young, so he had to go through and write all the sex scenes out of the game and recreate the game as "Legend of the Huggy Boy" for Patreon, which is why we now have a sex and no-sex version for download here.

What appears to have happened with itch.io is that an ethics group DMCA'd the game last week. This is an all-new wrinkle, and we don't have much more data than that it's an "ethics group" of some sort behind it. Selebus has stated that at least one KK-derived game has been restored to itch.io since the takedown, so it's probably only temporary.
Click to expand...
Basically what Barglenarglezous said, but the real kicker is about the history of this so called "ethics" group. They've been after multiple different games on Itch.io, according to Selebus, all Koikatsu based. They've lost their claims every time so far before any legal action was taken, but they are at major risk if a victim of these false takedowns takes them to court for being falsely claimed as they are then liable for any damages, including legal fees.

asiandude said:
Guys, sorry for being a little noob but can i applied update patch even tho i'm still at v. 0.21.p1? And how about guide mod? does the new version already covered yet?
Click to expand...
The patch may be updated to work with the newer versions, so it may not work on yours. If you still have sex scenes in your images folder, you don't need it (look for Miku or Molly images where they are topless, those were removed from the images folder and are restored with the patch. If you have those, you don't need the patch). The guide mod is updated only with the public version, so no, it is not yet up to date with the latest version of the game because the latest version is patron only at the moment.

nashk said:
Does the wiki really have ALL the hex translated? Is there a page for it all? Because there are several events that have hex or foreign languages that are not provided on the wiki pages for those events.



The guide mod is only updated up to the public release. So if you are downloading the latest release it won't be ready yet.
Click to expand...
I'm not sure if there is one to hold them all, but it does have all of that translated. If it isn't all on one, check the individual event pages.

barglenarglezous said:
Every single case of foreign languages that I've gone to the wiki to check has been translated, and since I don't bother to manually translate those, that's pretty much every case in which it appears.

I can't be quite as certain about the Hex/ROT stuff, because those are much less annoyiing to self-translate.
Click to expand...
They are, people here have said as much in the past.

nashk said:
Well looks like the Patreon got taken down. I'm getting sick of Patreon pulling shit like this.
Click to expand...
Probably the "ethics" group again if I had to guess, or some stupid troll reporting the game for violations it did not commit, or there is one more possibility, Patreon learned of the SubscribeStar version (Patreon does not like when creators use other sites to skirt Patreon rules, content that is removed for Patreon has to be removed in ALL versions or they take the Patreon page down. I have seen this multiple times). It was a full removal, too, no suspension this time (exactly like they usually do, one suspension and then it is gone).


Subeles said:
Copied from the Discord:

THIS IS AN SOS:
Despite there being literally zero adult content on Patreon, they have randomly decided to delete my page- removing roughly 80% of my income along with it.

I am hereby calling on all patrons to switch over their subscriptions to SubscribeStar because I have absolutely no idea what else to do at the moment.

2022 Has been a year comprised of nothing but headache after headache thus far, but I will not let it dissuade me from continuing to develop the game that brought all of us together.

There is still a chance the Patreon page gets reinstated seeing as I'm allowed an appeal and am fighting it as we speak, but given the service's likelihood to just try and fuck me whenever they please, I no longer encourage anyone to support me through them.

The future of the game depends on this move. I will not be able to keep creating it if I am no longer making a livable wage.

Subscribestar: https://subscribestar.adult/selebus
Annual Game Pass: https://selebus-inc.myshopify.com/products/lil-annual-game-pass
Click to expand...
I am SO sorry, man. This was completely undeserved and I am officially pissed at them, you have my continued support. I am quite literally in shock right now, this is the single biggest nightmare situation that I could see for the game and I had desperately hoped it would not come true.

Keep fighting, I for one have your back, as much as that's worth.

Subeles said:
I also have a Ko-fi page set up now for anyone interested in making a one-time donation instead of subscribing or purchasing merch.

https://ko-fi.com/selebus
Click to expand...
I'm short right now for anything extra, but I'll look into that and the game pass more seriously now, plus one of those shirts if they are still in stock when I get around to buying. Now, if you'll excuse me, the rage room awaits and I need to blow off some steam before I go off where I shouldn't.

chickenmaid said:
I agree, there's no point in appeasing them because they are fickle when it comes to their moral guidelines. Kamuo had to remove an animation because of their drawn face alone, 18+ voice actor have censor their non-visual content, erotic novelists too. Censorship when it comes to fictional content is so arbitrary at times. But Patreon content creators continue get on their knees because money is king.
Click to expand...
Moral guidelines? That's the funniest thing I've heard since the new rules were implemented. They answer to their payment processors and credit card companies. There were no moral guidelines, there never were, it was all about keeping the money going because those processors and card companies have business in countries that severely ban certain content and basically demanded a crackdown.

This is why Patreon is a mortal enemy I will never turn to for money.

barglenarglezous said:
They're enforcing a very different set of terms of use than they have posted lately.
Click to expand...
They are and that is unacceptable. Creators need to start opposing this.
